thread:
samir: Quick follow-up from PM-2910: recurring slow-tail under sustained load. We need concrete, testable follow-ups that land in CI and are runnable in monthly drills. Propose three tickets: prompt corpus, bounded load job, and routing/fallback harness.

olga: Sounds good. I'll own the prompt corpus. Plan: 110 prompts sampled from incident dumps, split into 'latency' and 'semantic' with a small core of 25 that run on every deploy. Will attach CSV + validator hints. Ticket INF-4991. ETA 5 days.

riju: I'll take the bounded load job. Stage-only, 12m run with a 2m ramp 30->650 qps, and optional KV eviction at T+7m. Validation: p95 guardrail, and no >1% sustained 5xx. Ticket INF-4992. I'll prototype scripts in infra/tests/load.

marc: I'll build the fallback/resilience harness and CI glue. Need a mock routing table and a runner that can flip variants during a run and assert no error-rate spike. Ticket INF-4993. ETA ~8 business days.

ops-bot: New issue created: INF-4991 by olga - "prompt corpus: incident-tail samples (110)"

ops-bot: New issue created: INF-4992 by riju - "stage load: 12m ramp + optional KV eviction"

ops-bot: New issue created: INF-4993 by marc - "fallback resilience harness + CI integration"

samir: Notes on validators: latency-only prompts should avoid token equality. Use prefix match, length ranges, or regex. Semantic prompts get stricter checks (prefix or matcher). Core set gets token-level where stable.

olga: Yep. CSV columns: prompt_id, category, source_incident, validator_hint, ci_core_flag. Will cite S3 traces for provenance.

riju: Repro snippet for INF-4992 (will include in ticket):
```
# example wrk invocation
wrk -t8 -c350 -d12m --latency http://stage.redwood/api/v1/generate -s scripts/long_seq.lua
# optional KV eviction (small subset)
kubectl -n inference rollout restart deploy/kv-cache --selector=worker-zone!=zone-a --timeout=60s
```
Add monitoring hooks to capture per-host kv-miss and p95.

marc: For the harness I'll accept a mock-routing.json and a simple runner that toggles entries mid-run. Harness asserts error-rate <= 0.5% increase over baseline and p95 <= 1.5x baseline. I'll add a `ci/evals/incident-resilience` job.

samir: Please link all INF tickets back to PM-2910 and add a reproducibility checklist (script + sample data + dashboard tile) before marking ready. We'll review at the ops sync in two weeks and demo owners.

olga: PR draft incoming. I'll include 110 prompts and mark the 25-core ones.

ops-bot: Linked INF-4991 -> PM-2910; INF-4992 -> PM-2910; INF-4993 -> PM-2910

riju: Timeline in INF-4992: prototype job in 3 days, staging job in 7 days, smoke run + baseline capture in 10 days.

marc: I'll attach mock-routing.json and a sample unit test that flips routes and asserts no regression. INF-4993 ETA updated to 7 business days.

samir: Great. Add an "owner sign-off" line in the ops sync agenda so each owner demos artifacts. If a ticket slips, add blocker comments. Closing loop in two weeks. :thumbsup:
